title: Text: DET Al Avila ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I have my guys coming over in a few minutes for a cocktail and then dinner. Possibly we can smoke a cigar after if you want to but I want to be in bed early.
I want to be in bed early, too. I wake up at 5:30 to work out. Text me after
OK will do. Your an animal. I wake up at 6am to go to daily Mass.
That’s why your skinny and I am fat
I can’t work out after the games are over, too late, so I have to get in a routine
Who are you going to dinner with
If it’s good people, invite me. I’m hungry
My guys that are my VP’s that you wrote about last year
